The '''Zongorlu system''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was invaded by the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zongorlu]].
